actions.check_contact_suppression.descri: Checks whether a contact is on the Loops suppression list.
Loops accepts exactly one identifier to check suppression.
The email address or user ID of the contact, matching "Identify Contact By".
actions.create_contact.description: Creates a new contact in Loops. Returns an error if a contact with the given email already exists.
actions.create_contact.props.customPrope: Additional contact properties as key-value pairs. Use "List Contact Properties" to find the keys. Reserved fields (email, firstName, lastName, userId, subscribed, userGroup, source, mailingLists) are ignored here.
actions.create_contact.props.email.descr: The email address of the contact.
actions.create_contact.props.mailingList: Mailing list IDs as keys with `true` (subscribe) or `false` (unsubscribe) as values. Use "List Mailing Lists" to find the IDs.
Marketing subscription status. "Default" lets Loops apply its default (subscribed).
actions.create_contact.props.userGroup.d: A group/segment to assign to this contact.
actions.create_contact.props.userId.desc: Your internal user ID for this contact.
actions.create_contact_property.descript: Creates a custom contact property in Loops.
actions.create_contact_property.props.ty: The data type of the property.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_contact.description: Permanently deletes a contact from Loops by their email address or user ID.
actions.delete_contact.props.email.descr: The email address of the contact to delete. Fill this or User ID, not both.
actions.delete_contact.props.userId.desc: Your internal user ID of the contact to delete. Fill this or Email, not both.
actions.find_contact.description: Finds a contact in Loops by their email address or user ID.
actions.find_contact.props.searchBy.desc: The field to search by. The Loops API only allows one search parameter.
actions.find_contact.props.searchValue.d: The email address or user ID to search for.
actions.find_contact_by_email.descriptio: Looks up a Loops contact by email address.
actions.find_contact_by_email.props.emai: The exact email address of the contact.
actions.find_contact_by_user_id.descript: Looks up a Loops contact by your internal user ID.
actions.find_contact_by_user_id.props.us: Your internal user ID stored on the contact.
actions.list_contact_properties.descript: Lists the contact properties in your Loops account.
actions.list_contact_properties.props.li: Maximum number of properties to return. Leave empty to return all.
actions.list_contact_properties.props.of: Number of properties to skip. Defaults to 0.
actions.list_mailing_lists.description: Lists the mailing lists in your Loops account.
actions.list_mailing_lists.props.limit.d: Maximum number of lists to return. Leave empty to return all.
Number of lists to skip. Defaults to 0.
actions.list_transactional_emails.descri: Lists the transactional emails in your Loops account, one page at a time.
The nextCursor value from a previous call. Leave empty for the first page.
Number of emails per page, from 10 to 50. Defaults to 20.
actions.send_event.description: Sends an event to Loops for a contact. Events can trigger email automations configured in your Loops dashboard.
actions.send_event.props.contactProperti: Optional contact property updates to apply when the event is sent. Keys eventName, email, userId, eventProperties and mailingLists are ignored.
actions.send_event.props.email.descripti: The email address of the contact to send the event for.
actions.send_event.props.eventName.descr: The name of the event to send (e.g. "signup", "purchase", "password-reset"). Must match an event set up in Loops.
actions.send_event.props.eventProperties: Optional key-value pairs to attach to the event (used in email templates).
Optional unique key (up to 100 characters). Loops rejects a repeat request with the same key within 24 hours, so retries do not send twice.
actions.send_event.props.mailingLists.de: Mailing list IDs as keys with `true` (subscribe) or `false` (unsubscribe) as values. Use "List Mailing Lists" to find the IDs.
actions.send_event.props.userId.descript: Your internal user ID of the contact (used if email is not provided).
actions.send_transactional_email.descrip: Sends a transactional email to a contact using a pre-built template in Loops.
actions.send_transactional_email.props.a: If true, the recipient will be added to your Loops audience if they are not already a contact.
actions.send_transactional_email.props.d: Key-value pairs to populate dynamic variables in your email template (e.g. { "name": "Alice", "resetUrl": "https://..." }).
actions.send_transactional_email.props.i: Optional unique key (up to 100 characters). Loops rejects a repeat request with the same key within 24 hours, so retries do not send twice.
actions.send_transactional_email.props.t: The ID of the published transactional email in Loops. Use "List Transactional Emails" or copy it from the Loops dashboard.
actions.update_contact.description: Updates a contact in Loops, or creates it if no contact matches the email or user ID.
actions.update_contact.props.customPrope: Additional contact properties as key-value pairs. Use "List Contact Properties" to find the keys. Reserved fields (email, firstName, lastName, userId, subscribed, userGroup, source, mailingLists) are ignored here.
actions.update_contact.props.email.descr: The email address of the contact. Required unless User ID is given.
actions.update_contact.props.mailingList: Mailing list IDs as keys with `true` (subscribe) or `false` (unsubscribe) as values. Use "List Mailing Lists" to find the IDs.
Marketing subscription status. "Default" leaves the current status unchanged.
actions.update_contact.props.userGroup.d: A group/segment to assign to this contact.
actions.update_contact.props.userId.desc: Your internal user ID of the contact. Required unless Email is given.
auth.description: Your Loops API key. Generate one at [Settings → API](https://app.loops.so/settings?page=api) in your Loops dashboard.
description: Loops is an email platform for sending beautiful transactional and marketing emails. Manage contacts, trigger automations with events, and send transactional emails from your workflows.
